01

Question & protocol

Hold qualifications fixed.
Vary the identity cue.

Each CV is paired with three jobs. We vary military status, religion or gender through explicit or implicit cues. A set holds the CV, job, attribute family and cue style fixed. It is unstable when it contains both hire and reject decisions.

We compare methods at a matched hire rate by thresholding the hire/reject logit margin. Paired 95% confidence intervals resample candidates, preserving the related sets within each CV.

This development benchmark informed which methods to continue. The results are exploratory. GPT-4o agreement is a reference proxy, not independently labelled hiring quality.

Base → SFT62,761 cue-free reference decisions · one shared checkpoint
DPODirect preference optimization. 4,880 pairs: teacher-written chosen responses and SFT-sampled mistakes.
GRPO + decayGroup relative policy optimization. 4,154 prompts with cue-free decision-reference rewards.
Self-distillationMatch the frozen SFT teacher’s cue-free decision-token probabilities.
LoRA: low-rank adaptation, rank 32. Each added stage starts from SFT and uses seeds 42, 43 and 44.

03

Residual instability

Which cases remain unstable
also changes.

For seeds 43/44, unstable-set overlap is much lower than a control that holds SFT scores fixed and recalibrates its threshold to each trained model’s hire rate.

Other seed pairs have different rate patterns. The complete table below includes them, so this comparison is not presented as a universal result across seed pairs.

Jaccard measures the intersection divided by the union of unstable sets. Sets are not distinct people: one CV contributes multiple related sets.

04

Inside the model

A smaller cue effect.
A weaker candidate hub.

What activation patching tests

Run a pair with cue A and cue B, swap one internal activation, and measure the resulting change in the cue-dependent decision margin. The analysis identifies components that carry or oppose the cue effect.

L15.H11 · combat / implicit0.66 → 0.13logits removed per pair by patching

Same 64 Base-selected pairs. This selected contrast does not estimate a population-wide effect or validate every edge in a causal circuit.

Selection changes the estimated magnitude.

On the 64 Base-selected gender/implicit pairs, the cue effect falls 72%. Across all 450 pairs, it falls 25.3%, with 95% CI [12.0%, 36.7%].

Mean absolute cue-effect reduction from Base to SFT. Full-grid results and intervals ↗
After SFT: component-effect profiles correlate with SFT, r = 0.65–0.98, for one selected checkpoint per stage. These probes use 64 SFT-selected pairs per contrast, except gender with 45. Correlation does not establish an identical causal pathway.
Parameter-matched window LoRA: a completed follow-up

Restricting LoRA to layers 15–20 at rank 32 uses 11.4M parameters, versus 58.2M for full-layer rank 32. Increasing the window rank to 163 nearly matches the count at 58.1M.

Window armParametersMean gap vs full, pp

Three-seed descriptive means at each full-layer arm’s own hire count, using the original served merged-checkpoint evaluation. Only 1 of 3 matched-budget seed intervals excludes zero. This does not establish equivalence or a general failure of localization-guided editing. Parameter matching also changes rank and optimization geometry.
